name: move-readback
title: Move Readback
description: Move confirmation that reads back the destination path with the folder setting access highlighted, how many people gain or lose access, path links that break (with a redirect option) and inherited settings that change, and relabels the button when access widens.

meta.stops: Helps prevent a private doc being moved into a public folder
meta.summary: Before moving an item, reads back who gains or loses access, which links break and which settings change, so a private doc doesn't land in a public folder.
meta.server: Re-check permissions and apply the move server-side; recompute access after it.
catches: Moves that make an item visible to more people
Moves that remove access for people who had it
Path links that will break, with a keep-redirect option
Inherited settings (retention, sharing) that change at the destination
limits: Viewer counts and settings come from your props; it doesn't query permissions
Direct shares on the item are only as accurate as your data
a11y: Form labelled by its title; paths are labelled ordered lists
Impact list is a polite live region; the arrow between states has an accessible name
Highlight animation is skipped under reduced motion
